subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should the experimental exporter ship now as an exact-state-only operation, with drifted or partial installed agents rejected until a separately specified snapshot-and-lineage mode exists?
rationale: The proposed strict behavior is a product contract for portability and customer-role reproducibility, not a mechanical implementation detail; a maintainer must decide whether rejecting partial state is acceptable for the first experimental release.

options.title: Approve exact-state-only export
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed exporter as the first experimental contract and require current-head proof for both clean export and incomplete-state rejection.

options.title: Design snapshot mode first
options.body: Pause this slice until export can distinguish an exact reproducible package from an explicit drifted snapshot with machine-readable lineage.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Limit this slice to a documented subset of immutable managed state and defer broader role reproducibility until the lifecycle stack is complete.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-state-only export
recommendation.body: Keep the current fail-closed exporter as the first experimental contract and require current-head proof for both clean export and incomplete-state rejection.
